parties: Warnakulasooriya Leo Herbert Ranjith Fernando v. The Finance Company (Pvt) Limited and Others Warnakulasooriya Leo Herbert Ranjith Fernando v. The Finance Company (Pvt) Limited and Others View More
keywords: The Appellant challenged the Additional District Court’s judgment holding him liable as guarantor under a hire purchase agreement, contending that the agreement had not been explained to him, that he had signed blank papers, and that there was no consideration. Held - defences were unsupported by evidence; the principal debtor had admitted receipt of consideration and default. Appeal dismissed with costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
